verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a plugin platform could plausibly offer sandboxed test environments that isolate production data. The pack documents no such capability. The 'local marketplace entry for testing' only covers testing plugin distribution, not data isolation. The community read-only connection and DROP/DELETE-blocking MCP scripts are user-side workarounds, not product features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
